content: Nature Communications still identifies the article as Multimodal radiopathomics model predicts postoperative metachronous liver metastasis in gastric cancer, published 04 September 2026. Its abstract says the RCSA model combines preoperative CT radiomic features, pathology-slide features and conventional clinical features; it was trained at one hospital and checked on separate internal, external, public and prospective-trial groups. The page still presents this as a prediction study and contains no correction or retraction notice.
